summary: Sandbach United put on a dominant display at Hind Heath Road, demolishing Widnes Town 6-0 in emphatic fashion with goals from Kyle Foley (2), Kieran O'Connell, Stan Tatters, Nathan Barry and Robbie Hatton. The performance featured delightful attacking football and countless chances created, with Stan Tatters and Kyle Foley particularly impressive throughout the match. The Bach are clearly in excellent form and will be looking to carry this momentum into their next fixture.
